title: Local Vault
summary: An offline-first personal document vault that minimizes collection and keeps decryption keys on the user device.
intended_users: People storing sensitive household records on shared or intermittently connected devices.

design_decisions.problem_or_constraint: Local-first custody, recovery, and metadata trade-offs are compared and traced to code boundaries.
design_decisions.alternatives_considered: The committed decision record compares credible alternatives and their security, access, maintenance, or operational trade-offs.
design_decisions.chosen_approach_and_rationale: Cryptography, persistence, policy, and recovery responsibilities have stable isolated interfaces.
design_decisions.accepted_trade_off: Plaintext necessarily exists briefly in process memory during an authorized read.
design_decisions.validation_approach: Reject any envelope whose authenticated bytes or metadata changed. Return a bounded authentication error for an incorrect key. Refuse disclosure after the configured retention boundary.
design_decisions.reconsideration_conditions: Plaintext necessarily exists briefly in process memory during an authorized read. The project does not protect an unlocked device controlled by a privileged attacker.

testing_strategy: Committed negative and boundary evidence: test/vault-adversarial.test.js, test/vault-adversarial.test.js, test/vault-adversarial.test.js. Finch static review does not establish that these tests pass.
security_threat: An attacker modifies ciphertext or envelope metadata on local storage. Control: Authenticated encryption binds version and record metadata before any plaintext is returned. Expired sensitive records remain readable beyond the user-selected retention window. Control: The service checks retention policy before decrypting and exposes an explicit purge operation.
production_limitation: Plaintext necessarily exists briefly in process memory during an authorized read. The project does not protect an unlocked device controlled by a privileged attacker.
technical_debt: Address the documented residual risks and add deployment-specific runtime evaluation before production use.
track_alignment_explanation: The product primarily minimizes disclosure through local custody, authenticated storage, retention, and explicit recovery controls.
